_comment: GDD §6 'The Garden: seeds, fruit and the creeper'. Which flags and choices plant which seeds, each with the sentence it came from. A source is 'flag:<name>' or 'choice:<line_id>:<card_index>'. Kinds: sweet (giving, patience, help), bitter (taking, pride, holding), weed (a desire that looks like devotion). Read by scripts/core/garden.gd; nothing here is ever shown as a number.

creeper._comment: The creeper's seed is given, never found (Madhuri, beat 14; another feature sets the flag). It climbs one step per watered play-day; at shade_steps it shades the saplings and they stop fruiting.

waters._comment: Flags of hearing, chanting, remembering and service. A play-day on which one of these is newly set waters the creeper once.

growth._comment: Play-days since planting. A play-day is a calendar date on which the player played; the clock between plays counts for nothing (GDD §16a).
